title: Equil 5.4 battery and control issue
body:
Hi. I've some issues with equil pump.

I paired it following AAPS instructions, bolus was working fine but battery was showing 0% and I've been getting battery warnings. I decided to change the battery. After that I couldn't setup piston. I recharged fully two batteries, neither of them works, pump didn't respond to any command. I couldn't unpair it, move the piston nor provide bolus. When trying to unpair AAPS displayed message about pump error. After restarting my phone I was able to pair it again. I was able to bolus, but battery was still reported at 0%. Then I tried to bolus 0.07 (clamped to 0.05), it failed on bolus progress screen. I was not able to bolus after that.

I am using new Equil with firmware V4. AAPS v3.4.2.2

It's impossible to unpair pump from AAPS. Once paired I can't get back to original remote.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1777912484395.logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27494310/AndroidAPS_LOG_1777912484395.log.zip)

it's mentioned everywhere
